evidence.title: Incident Briefing: Brussels Synthesis
evidence.content: Renata has assigned this case herself, off-queue. Dr. Farida Kessler has broken no single law any one jurisdiction can prosecute — LOOM's outputs look, individually, exactly like the accidents and coincidences the player spent nine cases proving were engineered. This submission must be built from evidence across all nine prior cases, bundled through the PRIOR CASE EVIDENCE panel.

evidence.title: Kessler's Internal Memo — Recovered
evidence.content:
RECOVERED — KESSLER, PERSONAL

"Instability is the only truly renewable resource. The Underwriters were never buying secrecy. They were buying scheduling. I never manufactured a single lie — I only automated the identification of real, exploitable weaknesses that already existed. That is, I am told, very good forensic investigation. I simply chose what to do with it."

chat.text: No queue today. No suggestions. This one's just you and me, and everything we've both put together since Case 001.
You're going to need the old files. All of them. Bundle it into one submission — the only kind of case this ever really was.

There is no incriminating footage here, deliberately. Kessler does nothing wrong-looking on camera, ever. The case was never going to be won on this floor.

solution.successMessage: No single piece of this ever would have held. Together, bundled from nine cases you closed one at a time, it draws exactly what it needed to: not a crime, a design. The CRSB, Ashcroft's own clients, and HER STORY's institutional partners sever ties with Corvid Systems simultaneously. LOOM survives, diminished and unfunded. Kessler disappears from every system you have access to.

onDocument.c10_ev02: She never manufactured a single lie. That's almost worse than if she had.

onFlag.MEMO_CHAIN_COMPLETE: The whole philosophy, in her own words. Instability, sold as a subscription.

onBookmark.c10_ev04: Bookmarked. A new COR-19 entry, filed after this closes, somewhere you've never been. Case 010 doesn't feel like an ending so much as a pause.

narrativeBeats.onSubmitSuccess: Kessler isn't arrested — nothing you found does that to a system. But the standards machinery Lindgren died defending finally does its job. It's a win. It's just not a clean one. Somewhere, a chalk-marked crate from Case 001 still feels a little too convenient to have been luck.
